gaps: At planet scale the component engine does not apply: a tap marks where a fire starts on the globe, and nothing spreads between the surface and the clouds.
No PSI/NTRS dataset covers wildfires or large-scale fire on Earth; the archive is about spacecraft fire safety.
Energetic components: none, so there is no rupture.
